state_census_1845.reason: No complete official statewide federal-style total for 1845-03-03 was verified in Census Bureau tables; archival state census coverage is incomplete and not interchangeable with decennial resident totals.

statewide_decennial_series.caveat: Census Bureau notes Southern undercount in 1870; no official state-level correction published in Forstall 1996

forstall1996.title: Population of States and Counties of the United States: 1790 to 1990

census_apportionment_change_1910_2020.title: Change in Resident Population of the 50 States, the District of Columbia, and Puerto Rico: 1910 to 2020

caveats: Statehood on 1845-03-03 is a political event, not a census observation. Do not invent or interpolate a March 3, 1845 population.
Federal Florida coverage begins with the 1830 census (territorial). Forstall notes from 1830 on, all parts of Florida have had census coverage.
Reference dates vary: 1830-1900 June 1; 1910 April 15; 1920 January 1; 1930-2020 April 1 (Forstall census-dates section; modern April 1 is standard).
Enslaved people were counted in early federal censuses; free Black residents were counted. Voting and rights were not universal.

American Indians generally were not counted before 1890 unless considered part of the broader non-Indian society (taxes/settled communities). Forstall: tribal Indians omitted intentionally prior to 1890.
1870 Southern undercount is acknowledged by Census; Forstall does not apply a Florida-specific corrected total.
County boundaries changed repeatedly; today's 67 counties did not exist in 1830/1840/1850. Do not map historical county counts onto modern polygons without historical boundaries.
Forstall Part IV marks Florida first census 1830 and state outer extent essentially unchanged since 1830; county lines continued to change.

recommended_staged_scope: Stage A: Statewide decennial timeline 1830-2020 with statehood marker on 1845-03-03 (event annotation only; nearest observations 1840 territorial and 1850 state).
Stage B: Optional archival note about 1845 Florida state census (incomplete) without presenting a fabricated day-of-statehood total.

Stage C: Later — historical county layers only with Newberry AHCB (or equivalent official) boundaries matched to Forstall county tables for selected years; never modern 67-county polygons for 1840 counts.
